verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox for safely building and testing "without affecting live production data". It has its own frontend (demo.ramp.com) and API base (demo-api.ramp.com), moves no real money, and includes a demo actions panel for simulating events. The AI-native surfaces target it directly: the CLI connects to Sandbox by default, and a demo-data MCP endpoint (demo-mcp.ramp.com/mcp) is published. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox and demo MCP endpoints work as documented (no probe hit them).
